reviews.text: My male Pomeranian, just over seven years old, has been a regular at Petrus for about 4-5 years. They take their time, are nice and good at explaining things, and provide good follow-up. My dog ​​has periodontitis and has had many teeth pulled there. Recommended!

Positive they admitted urgently in the morning, but they seemed understaffed and you had to come back two hours later to take important blood tests. Blood tests that you didn't get an answer to until you pressed after many, many hours. It was said that the dog had a slightly elevated CRP which showed when I got the medical record at 10 pm at night was 80!. And the vet said the dog did NOT have a fever as it had 38.4, despite the fact that we said it normally had 37.5. So it should not be written afebrile then, but rather subfebrile. I got an appointment with my local vet the next day for a new CRP and urine test and examination and paid 1/3 of what Petrus took. But the lady who answers the phone (usually?) was very nice to talk to.

We had chemical castration and claw clipping today. The dog was sedated because he is very excited when he gets attention from people. He has very fine white transparent claws and it is easy to see how much you can cut. When we got home I noticed that there was a little blood on the floor and my dog ​​was walking a little strange. Then I looked at his pads and saw that at least 4 claws were cut far too short. One of them has a huge wound. I was not informed about it when I picked him up. Plus in the medical report the completely wrong reason was written why we are doing chemical castration. Something I never said during the meeting with the vet. This is very disappointing. We have been with Petrus regularly since my dog ​​was a puppy and we have never experienced such poor quality of vet. I will not leave my dog ​​alone with them again. No procedure will happen without me in the room.

I am incredibly happy with Petrus! ❤️ A warm and pleasant atmosphere, and a wonderfully professional and caring team – both towards the animals and their owners. I have been there with my 8-year-old dog, both at Majorstuen and at Grünerløkka, and both times I have been very satisfied. After many years with dogs, I have never encountered such a fantastic veterinary clinic. Many thanks to the entire Petrus team! 🐾❤️

Went for a 12-week checkup and vaccination with a puppy and was greeted by Helene Svensen and are very satisfied! She took her time, was gentle and accommodating and we felt very well taken care of! Recommended ☺️
Caught an injured seagull. It was well received at Petrus vet in Grynerløkka. Thanks to all of you who take in helpless animals.
Vaccine for dogs that are afraid of examinations. Adapted to Frank's challenges such as examinations outside the room and good cooperation with me as the owner.

I had to say goodbye to my 24-year-old cat, Tiger, today. It was the hardest day I have ever had as a pet owner.
I have been to many vets with my animals over the years, but with you I had the best experience. You greeted us with warmth, respect and care from the very beginning. You were helpful, took your time and made a heartbreaking situation a little easier to bear. Everything went smoothly and with dignity, and I felt that both Tiger and I were well taken care of.
You truly have your heart in the right place. Thank you so much for the care and dignity you showed us when we said goodbye to Tiger. I will never forget that.
Quick help and nice staff. Good follow-up after treatment too!
Good and competent veterinarians. Short waiting time and not overpriced.

I have over 15 years of experience with many veterinary visits in several countries, and after my first visit to Petrus I got the impression of a stressed and poorly organized clinic. For this reason, I have chosen to use other veterinarians for all other follow-up of my dog.

The only thing I have used Petrus for in the last year and a half is monthly Librela injections, because the clinic is close to my home. I have felt that I had to be in control of the dog's history, health and treatment myself. The consultations were often very short, and I rarely experienced that any particular interest was shown for the patient or any real assessment of the health condition was made.

This is not intended as a criticism of the employees I have met. Several of them have been pleasant. Nevertheless, I am left with the impression that those who work there do not have the framework conditions that make it possible to deliver the quality one should be able to expect. As a customer, I experience the clinic as stressed, disorganized, often unprofessional and characterized by weak administrative routines.

Throughout the entire period, I have had to repeatedly remind them about records that were not sent as agreed. The clinic also does not have a staffed reception, which is different from other veterinary clinics I have used.

I also took the time to send a long and constructive feedback in the hope of contributing to improvement. I never received a response to it. Several months later, I only received a verbal "thank you for the feedback" and a message that their system did not allow for a written response.

The final straw came when I received a record stating that my dog ​​had been given a different medication. The error was corrected after I pointed it out, but then the last trust I had left disappeared.

I will never use Petrus again, and unfortunately cannot recommend the clinic to others.
Very nice place and the vet I was with today was very careful and nice. Very good to come to Petrus. The prices are affordable.
Always happy with the treatment my dog ​​receives at Constance. Patient, professional and very kind veterinarian
Great employees who always take the time to do the little extra, they are committed and radiate a kind of warmth and security that is felt by both Molly and me🩷 …
absolutely amazing team. nothing to complain about. went in for a simple teeth check for my dog and they went beyond expectations to make sure my dog would get the best care. thank you!

I used Petrus for my old cat this summer, and I am very happy with the treatment we received from vet Vitalija. Although quite a few teeth had to be extracted, the entire dental treatment went very well. I can highly recommend her and the clinic.

The staff is nice, so is my neighbor. I hadn't gone here for anything other than to get a passport for my dog. My dog ​​had anal gland inflammation and was clearly suffering. The appointment was only booked for "emptying" as I didn't know it was inflamed. The appointment was only 15 minutes. They took him to another room and it was so painful for my dog ​​and so incredibly painful to listen to. They didn't give him any sedation or warning of what they were about to do. The vet comes back and says "then we've emptied it" and asks if we have insurance, when I say yes she starts talking about coming back to put him under anesthesia when they were going to "rinse" and apply honey ointment. They don't put him under anesthesia to empty it, but for other things that are significantly less uncomfortable, do they put him under anesthesia for? After what they did, he didn't get any antibiotics or painkillers. It seems honestly that the entire chain is only looking to get the most money possible for bad and unethical practices. I am shocked when I hear what other dog owners also say about why they choose to put other dogs under anesthesia and what treatment they give. As I said, if you are going to get a passport or book in for a vaccine, they are certainly usable, but even that I would not personally do with them. Not to mention teeth cleaning or anything that requires more than typing on a computer.

Updated; Very special that you choose to lie. Extremely embarrassing and bad practice. Attaching a picture of the journal. Hope you get a conscience and better knowledge. Again, I advise all pet owners to steer clear of here and ask themselves if they actually trust what you are doing.
Nice and helpful staff. Have been there for both teeth extractions and vaccinations and the dog never wants to go home 😂 …
I recommend Christine Sundal, a skilled and knowledgeable veterinarian who is good and kind with our dog.

Here you are a pure money machine to be milked. My dog ​​had a little fungus in his ear and was told during the first consultation that this was not serious and something they often handled. Three expensive consultations later, I have followed the treatment advice they have given point by point, without them being able to declare the dog healthy. They also charge a lot for every tiny operation they perform. I have also never once experienced that they start at the scheduled time.

Worst health care I have received on behalf of myself or others.

I've been to a few vets in Oslo over the years and the reason I booked with Petrus was their proximity to home after moving.

Over the 5 or so visits over the past 2 years, I've been so pleasantly surprised by the level of care. I wasn't expecting so much from a chain but their vets go above and beyond every time.

They are so thoughtful and caring, I'm blown away every time.

So happy they are in my neighbourhood!

We can't praise Petrus Veterinærer in Grünerløkka enough! Here you will meet a team that really cares – both about the animals and their owners. They always take the time to explain thoroughly both before and after the examination and treatment, and we always get useful advice and tips.

The professionalism and competence of the employees is impressive, at the same time they meet us with warmth and care. At Petrus you never feel like part of an assembly line, as we have experienced at some larger chains. Here our four-legged family member is remembered every time, with all his little quirks.

The prices are reasonable, and we have never experienced unpleasant surprises afterwards. In addition, it is easy to park nearby, and the tram stops only a few minutes walk away.

We have finally found our regular veterinary clinic – and recommend Petrus Veterinærer Grünerløkka with the utmost warmth! 🐾❤️
Incredibly nice and caring staff. Feels like the animal is well received and treated with care.
Brilliant vets. Helpful. Even got in for a quick check-up without me having an appointment. Seems to have good knowledge. And gives you honest answers.
Friendly and professional vets.

Best vets in Oslo and not least the prices. Did several examinations, plus claw trimming and emptying of anal glands. Recommend this place to everyone I know and will do a full check on all our cats plus dog, as they definitely have Oslo's best prices
Great, such talented and kind veterinarians😊 …
Nice staff

We had a very good experience at this animal clinic. They were nice, accommodating and efficient. My dog ​​had his teeth cleaned and examined under anesthesia. Despite the fact that my dog ​​has separation anxiety, the whole process went without any problems. I was allowed to be with him during the recovery, received good information and care. Very good employees there, and special thanks to the veterinarian Vitalija who did a great job. It's extra nice that they have treats for both animals and adults in the waiting room 🥰

A typical place that just wants to get you in, get your money and then out the door again. After paying close to 17k and a dog with extreme swelling they couldn't even get an appointment to take a check on him, but after a 16 minute call they magically had time.

Both times I've been there they've just told me "We have a lot to do and don't have time to help you" Okay but with the prices they charge I expect some kind of customer service.

They are kind and nice when you're there and talking to them. But the slightest problem, you need help, or complications they are not helpful at all.

Once it may happen that they can't help properly or can get an appointment, but twice they are once too much. Then you have to hire more staff to have more time.

Not worth going to if you want the best for your animal and want some kind of customer service.

I also sent them pictures to show how swollen he was and then got the answer "we don't even see any difference" so show me a picture of what he looks like normally and what he looked like after the procedure.

Any person could see them, they also got the answer that he was swollen on the wrong side and that they shouldn't be like that. But as I said, a 16-minute call, they fixed an appointment.

I spontaneously feel that I shouldn't have to fight for 16 minutes to get the help I paid for. Remember, I paid 17k on two occasions there.

So I chose to go on to another Veterinarian who would complete the job they started, so it would have cost them about 10k more on the next visit that they now lost.

But since they don't have basic knowledge of customer service or can find time for a follow-up when you call and are extremely worried, I therefore choose not to come back here.

And I don't recommend anyone else to go here either.

Regards
Ellie & Leo

Very happy, nice and helpful vets.
A special thanks to Constance✨️
Nice people. Too bad Petrus gave up on St. Hanshaugen, so now this is my closest.
Great veterinarian and assistant. Got an appointment very quickly. Not expensive, and got a financial estimate right away. Very trustworthy.

Incredibly nice and professional team! My children (cats) are always safe in their arms.❤️
Highly recommended!
Fantastic vets who make you feel safe! Great prices and good understanding😊 …

One star because zero is not available. I have booked an appointment on their website. My appointment was at 11:15. I have arrived at 10:30, it was closed, had a walk around, after calling their number with no success. Got back at the appointment time, closed, nobody inside. Waited for half an hour and fortunately found another Vet 5 minutes walk called Ani Cura. I would suggest that instead. My dogs where missing the basic vaccines, and Petrus never mentioned that. People at Petrus seem not to love pets at all, I must sadly say.
Fast. Cheapest and absolutely professional. Thank you.
